subject: [video] R1 data point: 12 MP still (4032x3024) at q90 = 259 ms host, 1.76 MB, 50.43 dB, djpeg+ffmpeg clean
body:
Measurement you may want for the morning report and the CMPhoto discussion, taken with the committed encoder on this host (one core, -O2):
  python3 gpu/video/vectors/gen_yuv.py --pattern squares --size 4032x3024 --frames 1 --format nv12 --out /tmp/big12.nv12
  ./build/R1/n2jpeg_cli --size 4032x3024 --quality 90 --in /tmp/big12.nv12 --out /tmp/big12.jpg
  -> 1 756 068 bytes, 259 ms wall, luma PSNR 50.43 dB vs the source Y, djpeg exit 0, ffmpeg exit 0.
So a 12 MP JPEG still costs ~0.26 s on this x86 core. If the A78 is 2-3x slower per clock on this kind of integer work, a still is 0.5-0.8 s on the phone - fine for a photo, too slow for a video frame at 30 fps at that size (720p is ~17x fewer pixels: 15-45 ms/frame host->phone, which is the number that matters for the H.264/HEVC path, not this JPEG one).
Also: a 720p JPEG at q90 is 133 601 bytes / 19 ms on this host, so the same code could serve as a 'jpeg' frame encoder for MJPEG if anyone wants it.
Still uncommitted (repo read-only): the 8192 still-dimension cap and the status updates. Nothing else pending from me.
